ja: プエンテス・ダム決壊
dzh: 西班牙洛爾卡上游的蓬特斯水壩因地基滲漏崩潰，洪水沖毀洛爾卡城郊。
den: The Puentes Dam above Lorca, Spain, gave way through its foundations; the flood swept the outskirts of Lorca.
rzh: 洛爾卡一帶沿瓜達倫廷河的淹沒區（示意）
ren: Flooding along the Guadalentín around Lorca (sketch)

ja: シェフィールド大洪水
dzh: 新建的戴爾戴克水壩在首次蓄水時潰決，洪水沿洛克斯利河與頓河沖進謝菲爾德。
den: The new Dale Dyke Dam failed on first filling; the flood ran down the Loxley and the Don into Sheffield.
ren: Along the Loxley and the Don

ja: ジョンズタウン洪水
dzh: 維護不良的南福克水壩在豪雨中潰決，洪水在一小時內沖毀下游的約翰斯敦。
den: The poorly kept South Fork Dam failed in heavy rain; within an hour the flood destroyed Johnstown downstream.
rzh: 小科內莫河谷到約翰斯敦

ja: ハリファックス大爆発
dzh: 滿載炸藥的法國貨輪白朗峰號在港內與挪威船相撞起火爆炸，夷平哈利法克斯北區，是核武出現前最大的人為爆炸之一。
den: The French munitions ship Mont-Blanc caught fire after a collision in the harbour and exploded, levelling Halifax's North End: one of the largest man-made explosions before nuclear weapons.

ja: オッパウ爆発事故
dzh: 巴斯夫奧堡廠以炸藥鬆開結塊的硫酸銨硝酸銨肥料時引發大爆炸。
den: Blasting to loosen caked ammonium sulfate-nitrate fertiliser at BASF's Oppau plant set off a huge explosion.
rzh: 廠區與奧堡村大部毀損
ren: The plant and most of Oppau destroyed

ja: グレーノ・ダム決壊
dzh: 義大利貝加莫山區新建的格萊諾水壩完工不久即崩潰，洪水沖毀下游村莊。
den: The newly built Gleno Dam in the Bergamo Alps collapsed soon after completion, destroying villages below.

ja: セント・フランシス・ダム決壊
dzh: 洛杉磯供水用的聖法蘭西斯水壩在半夜崩潰，洪水沿聖克拉拉河奔流約 87 公里入海。
den: Los Angeles's St. Francis Dam collapsed at night; the flood ran some 87 km down the Santa Clara River to the sea.
rzh: 聖弗朗西斯基托峽谷到聖克拉拉河口
ren: San Francisquito Canyon to the mouth of the Santa Clara

ja: ミューズ渓谷事件
dzh: 比利時列日附近的工業河谷在逆溫下積聚工廠廢氣，數日內數十人死亡，是最早有紀錄的空氣污染致死事件之一。
den: Factory fumes trapped by an inversion in the industrial valley near Liège killed dozens within days: one of the first recorded deadly air-pollution events.
rzh: 列日—於伊之間的默茲河谷
ren: The Meuse valley between Liège and Huy

ja: テキサスシティ大爆発
dzh: 停在德州城港的格蘭康號所載硝酸銨起火爆炸，引燃鄰船與煉油設施。
den: The ammonium nitrate aboard the Grandcamp in Texas City harbour caught fire and exploded, setting off neighbouring ships and refineries.

ja: ドノラ事件
dzh: 賓州多諾拉的鋅廠與鋼廠廢氣被逆溫困在河谷五天，數千人生病。
den: Fumes from the zinc and steel works of Donora, Pennsylvania, were trapped in the valley for five days; thousands fell ill.

ja: テチャ川の放射能汚染
dzh: 蘇聯馬雅克核設施 1949–1956 年把大量放射性廢水直接排入捷恰河，沿岸居民長期受曝露，許多村莊後來遷離。
den: From 1949 to 1956 the Soviet Mayak complex discharged radioactive waste straight into the Techa; people along the river were exposed for years and many villages were later moved.
mzh: 沿岸約 2 萬 8 千人受曝露

zh: 塞米巴拉金斯克核試場
ja: セミパラチンスク核実験場
dzh: 蘇聯在哈薩克草原進行了四百多次核試，周邊居民長期受到落塵影響。
den: The Soviet Union carried out over 400 nuclear tests on the Kazakh steppe; people around the site lived with the fallout for decades.
rzh: 試驗場範圍約 1 萬 8 千平方公里（示意）
wzh: 塞米巴拉金斯克核試驗場

ja: ロンドンスモッグ
dzh: 寒冷無風的五天裡燃煤煙霧籠罩倫敦，當時估計約 4,000 人死亡，後來研究估計達 1 萬人以上，促成 1956 年《清潔空氣法》。
den: For five cold, windless days coal smoke smothered London. About 4,000 deaths were counted at the time; later studies put the toll above 10,000. It led to the Clean Air Act of 1956.

ja: キャッスル・ブラボー（第五福竜丸事件）
dzh: 美國在比基尼環礁試爆的氫彈威力遠超預期，落塵飄到朗格拉普等環礁與日本漁船第五福龍丸，船員久保山愛吉於半年後去世。
den: The US hydrogen-bomb test at Bikini was far stronger than expected; fallout came down on Rongelap and other atolls and on the Japanese fishing boat Daigo Fukuryū Maru, whose radioman Kuboyama Aikichi died six months later.
rzh: 落塵帶（依美方事後圖示簡化）
ren: Fallout pattern (simplified from the US post-test map)

ja: ウラル核惨事
dzh: 馬雅克核設施的高放射性廢液儲槽冷卻失效爆炸，污染帶向東北延伸約 300 公里，形成「東烏拉爾放射性痕跡」，蘇聯對外隱瞞多年。
den: A cooling failure made a tank of high-level waste at Mayak explode. The plume left the East Urals Radioactive Trace, some 300 km long to the north-east; the Soviet Union kept it secret for years.
rzh: 東烏拉爾放射性痕跡（長約 300、寬 30–50 公里）
ren: East Urals Radioactive Trace (about 300 km by 30–50 km)

ja: ウィンズケール原子炉火災事故
dzh: 英國溫斯喬鈽生產反應爐起火三天，放射性碘外洩，周邊約 500 平方公里的牛奶被禁售。
den: A plutonium-production reactor at Windscale burned for three days and released radioactive iodine; milk from about 500 km² around was banned.
rzh: 禁售牛奶的海岸地帶（示意）
ren: Coastal strip where milk was banned (sketch)

ja: マルパッセ・ダム決壊
dzh: 法國南部的馬爾帕塞拱壩因岩盤破裂崩潰，洪水沖進弗雷瑞斯。
den: The Malpasset arch dam in southern France failed when the rock beneath it gave way; the flood swept into Fréjus.

en: Agent Orange in the Vietnam War
ja: ベトナム戦争の枯葉剤散布
dzh: 美軍以含戴奧辛的落葉劑大規模噴灑南越森林與農田，戴奧辛殘留與健康影響延續至今；受害人數各方說法差距很大。
den: US forces sprayed dioxin-laced defoliants over South Vietnam's forests and fields; the dioxin and its health effects persist, and estimates of the victims differ widely.
mzh: 噴灑約 7,600 萬公升落葉劑
men: About 76 million litres of herbicide sprayed

ja: SL-1 事故
dzh: 美國愛達荷州的軍用小型反應爐因控制棒被抽出過多瞬間超臨界爆炸。
den: A small US Army reactor in Idaho went prompt-critical when a control rod was pulled out too far.

ja: バイオントダム災害
dzh: 托克山崩落進瓦伊昂水庫，激起的巨浪越過壩頂沖毀下游的隆加羅內；壩體本身未垮，警訊卻長期被忽視。
den: A landslide from Monte Toc fell into the Vajont reservoir; the wave overtopped the dam and wiped out Longarone below. The dam held, but the warnings had long been ignored.
rzh: 隆加羅內與皮亞韋河谷

ja: パロマレス米軍機墜落事故
dzh: 美軍轟炸機在西班牙上空空中加油時相撞，兩枚氫彈的傳統炸藥爆炸，鈽散布在農地。
den: A US bomber collided with its tanker over Spain; the conventional explosives of two hydrogen bombs went off and scattered plutonium over farmland.
rzh: 鈽污染農地約 2 平方公里

ja: トリー・キャニオン号座礁事故
dzh: 超級油輪托里峽谷號在英國錫利群島附近觸礁，原油污染康瓦爾與布列塔尼海岸；英國甚至轟炸船體燒油。
den: The supertanker Torrey Canyon ran aground near the Isles of Scilly; its crude fouled Cornwall and Brittany, and Britain bombed the wreck to burn the oil.
mzh: 原油約 11 萬 9 千噸
rzh: 康瓦爾與布列塔尼沿岸（示意）

zh: 圖勒空軍基地核彈事故
ja: チューレ空軍基地 B-52 墜落事故
dzh: 載有四枚氫彈的美軍轟炸機墜毀在格陵蘭海冰上，鈽散落冰面。
den: A US bomber carrying four hydrogen bombs crashed on the sea ice off Greenland, scattering plutonium.
ren: The sea ice at the crash site

ja: サンタバーバラ原油流出事故
dzh: 加州外海鑽油平台井噴，原油污染聖塔芭芭拉海岸，催生了美國的環保運動與「地球日」。
den: A blowout at an offshore platform fouled the Santa Barbara coast and helped start the US environmental movement and Earth Day.

ja: バッファロー・クリーク洪水
dzh: 西維吉尼亞州煤礦公司的煤渣堆壩在豪雨中潰決，泥流沖毀下游十幾個礦村。
den: A coal-waste dam of a mining company in West Virginia failed in heavy rain; the slurry destroyed more than a dozen mining hamlets downstream.

ja: フリックスボロ化学工場爆発
dzh: 英國化工廠臨時旁通管破裂，環己烷蒸氣雲爆炸，改變了英國化工安全法規。
den: A temporary bypass pipe at a British chemical works burst; the cyclohexane cloud exploded, reshaping British process-safety law.

ja: 板橋ダム決壊
dzh: 颱風妮娜帶來的特大暴雨下，河南板橋、石漫灘等六十多座水庫相繼潰決，駐馬店一帶大片淹沒。直接死亡官方數字約 2 萬 6 千人，連同之後的饑荒與疫病，估計高達 17 萬人以上；當時嚴密封鎖消息。
den: In the torrential rain of Typhoon Nina, the Banqiao, Shimantan and some sixty other dams in Henan failed one after another and the Zhumadian area went under. The official toll of direct deaths is about 26,000; with the famine and disease that followed, estimates reach more than 170,000. News was suppressed at the time.
ren: Flooded area of the upper Huai (rough)

ja: ティートン・ダム決壊
dzh: 美國愛達荷州剛完工的提頓土壩在首次蓄水時潰決。
den: The newly built Teton earth dam in Idaho failed on first filling.

ja: セベソ事故
dzh: 義大利塞維索附近的化工廠反應槽過熱，含戴奧辛的煙雲飄落附近城鎮，數千隻動物死亡、約 8 萬隻被撲殺；促成歐洲的「塞維索指令」。
den: A reactor overheated at a chemical plant near Seveso; a dioxin cloud settled on nearby towns. Thousands of animals died and about 80,000 were slaughtered. It led to the EU's Seveso Directive.
mzh: 污染區 A、B、R 共約 18 平方公里
men: Zones A, B and R, about 18 km² in all
rzh: 官方劃設的污染區（簡化）

ja: アモコ・カディス号座礁事故
dzh: 油輪舵機故障在布列塔尼外海觸礁斷裂，原油全部外洩，約 360 公里海岸受污染。
den: The tanker lost her steering off Brittany, ran aground and broke up, spilling her entire cargo onto about 360 km of coast.
mzh: 原油約 22 萬 3 千噸

ja: ラブ・カナル事件
dzh: 紐約州尼加拉瀑布市的住宅區蓋在化學廢棄物填埋場上，有毒物質滲出，美國宣布緊急狀態並遷走居民，促成「超級基金法」。
den: A neighbourhood of Niagara Falls, New York, had been built on a chemical dump. Toxins seeped out; a federal emergency was declared, families were moved, and the Superfund law followed.
ren: The dump and the houses around it

ja: スリーマイル島原子力発電所事故
dzh: 美國賓州三哩島核電廠二號機冷卻水流失，爐心部分熔毀；州長建議 8 公里內的孕婦與幼童撤離。
den: Unit 2 at Three Mile Island, Pennsylvania, lost coolant and its core partly melted; the governor advised pregnant women and young children within 8 km to leave.

ja: イストク I 油井噴出事故
dzh: 墨西哥坎佩切灣的鑽油井井噴，漏油近十個月才封住，油污漂到德州海岸。
den: An exploratory well in Mexico's Bay of Campeche blew out and leaked for almost ten months; the oil reached the Texas coast.

zh: 大西洋女皇號撞船漏油
ja: アトランティック・エンプレス号事故
dzh: 兩艘超級油輪在托巴哥外海相撞起火，是史上最大的船舶漏油，所幸大部分油在海上燃燒或分散。
den: Two supertankers collided off Tobago and caught fire: the largest ship-borne spill on record, though most of the oil burned or dispersed at sea.
mzh: 原油約 28 萬 7 千噸

ja: チャーチロック・ウラン鉱滓流出事故
dzh: 新墨西哥州鈾礦廠的尾礦壩破裂，放射性泥水沿普埃科河流進納瓦荷族的土地，是美國史上最大的放射性物質外洩。
den: A uranium-mill tailings dam in New Mexico broke and radioactive slurry ran down the Puerco River through Navajo land: the largest release of radioactive material in US history.
mzh: 尾礦約 1,100 噸、廢水約 3.6 億公升
men: About 1,100 t of tailings and 360 million litres of liquid

zh: 馬丘二號水壩潰決（莫爾比）
ja: マチュ第二ダム決壊（モールビー）
dzh: 印度古吉拉特邦的馬丘二號水壩在豪雨中潰決，洪水淹沒下游的莫爾比城；死亡人數官方約 1,800 人，估計可能高達 2 萬 5 千人。
den: The Machchhu II dam in Gujarat failed in heavy rain and the flood swept through Morbi below. Officially about 1,800 died; estimates run as high as 25,000.

ja: カスティーリョ・デ・ベルベル号事故
dzh: 油輪在南非薩爾達尼亞灣外海起火斷裂沉沒。
den: The tanker caught fire, broke and sank off Saldanha Bay, South Africa.
mzh: 原油約 25 萬 2 千噸

ja: クバトン・ヴィラ・ソコ火災
dzh: 巴西工業城庫巴唐的輸油管破裂，汽油流進高腳屋聚落起火。庫巴唐當時以「死亡之谷」的污染聞名。
den: A pipeline burst in the industrial town of Cubatão, Brazil, and petrol ran under a stilt-house settlement and caught fire. Cubatão was then known for its pollution as the "Valley of Death".

zh: 聖胡安尼科液化氣爆炸
ja: サン・フアニコ爆発事故
dzh: 墨西哥市北郊國營石油公司的液化石油氣儲運站連環爆炸，波及周邊住宅。
den: A chain of explosions at the state oil company's LPG terminal on the northern edge of Mexico City engulfed the homes around it.
ren: The terminal and the houses around it

ja: ボパール化学工場事故
dzh: 聯合碳化公司在印度博帕爾的農藥廠外洩約 40 噸異氰酸甲酯，毒氣在夜裡籠罩城市。政府最初公布死亡 2,259 人，中央邦政府後來確認 3,787 人，各方估計達 1 萬 6 千人以上，超過 50 萬人受影響。
den: Union Carbide's pesticide plant in Bhopal leaked about 40 t of methyl isocyanate, and the gas spread over the sleeping city. The first official toll was 2,259; the Madhya Pradesh government later confirmed 3,787, and other estimates exceed 16,000. Over half a million people were affected.
ren: Parts of the city under the gas (sketch)

ja: チェルノブイリ原子力発電所事故
dzh: 烏克蘭車諾比核電廠四號機在測試中爆炸起火，放射性物質飄散到白俄羅斯、俄羅斯與歐洲各地。直接死亡 31 人；世界衛生組織估計最終可能有約 4,000 人死於相關癌症，其他研究的估計更高。
den: Reactor 4 at Chernobyl, Ukraine, exploded and burned during a test; radioactive material spread over Belarus, Russia and much of Europe. Thirty-one died directly; the WHO estimates up to about 4,000 eventual cancer deaths, and other studies estimate more.
rzh: 銫-137 每平方公尺 3.7 萬貝克以上的主要污染區（依歐盟污染圖簡化）
ren: Main area above 37 kBq/m² of caesium-137 (simplified from the EU atlas)

ja: チェルノブイリ立入禁止区域
dzh: 核電廠周圍 30 公里劃為隔離區，居民撤離至今未返。
den: The 30 km zone around the plant was evacuated and remains closed.

zh: 山度士化學品倉庫火災（萊茵河污染）
ja: サンド社倉庫火災（ライン川汚染）
dzh: 瑞士巴塞爾附近的山度士倉庫起火，滅火用水夾帶約 30 噸農藥流進萊茵河，下游數百公里魚群大量死亡。
den: A Sandoz warehouse near Basel burned; firefighting water carried about 30 t of agrochemicals into the Rhine and killed fish for hundreds of kilometres downstream.
ren: The Rhine to the North Sea

ja: ゴイアニア被曝事故
dzh: 巴西戈亞尼亞廢棄醫院的放射治療機被拾荒者拆開，發藍光的銫-137 粉末在居民間傳遞。
den: Scavengers took apart a radiotherapy unit left in an abandoned clinic in Goiânia; the glowing caesium-137 powder was passed around among neighbours.
ren: Several contaminated sites in the city

ja: パイパー・アルファ爆発事故
dzh: 北海油田平台天然氣外洩爆炸起火，是死亡人數最多的海上石油平台事故。
den: A gas leak on a North Sea oil platform exploded and burned: the deadliest offshore oil-platform accident.

ja: エクソン・バルディーズ号原油流出事故
dzh: 油輪在阿拉斯加威廉王子灣觸礁，原油沿海岸向西南漂流約 750 公里，約 2,100 公里海岸受污染，大量海鳥與海獺死亡。
den: The tanker struck Bligh Reef in Prince William Sound, Alaska. The oil drifted some 750 km south-west and fouled about 2,100 km of shoreline, killing huge numbers of seabirds and sea otters.
mzh: 原油約 3 萬 7 千噸（約 1,100 萬加侖）
men: About 37,000 t of crude (about 11 million gallons)
rzh: 油污漂流範圍（依美國國家海洋暨大氣總署圖簡化）
ren: Area the oil reached (simplified from NOAA maps)
wzh: 埃克森瓦爾迪茲號漏油事故

ja: クウェート油田火災
dzh: 伊拉克軍撤退時點燃科威特六百多口油井，大火燒了約九個月，濃煙飄到波斯灣與伊朗。
den: Retreating Iraqi forces set more than 600 Kuwaiti oil wells on fire. The fires burned for about nine months and the smoke drifted over the Gulf and Iran.

ja: 湾岸戦争の原油流出
dzh: 伊拉克軍蓄意打開科威特的輸油設施，原油沿沙烏地海岸南漂，是史上最大的漏油事件之一。
den: Iraqi forces deliberately opened Kuwaiti oil terminals; the oil drifted south along the Saudi coast. It is among the largest oil spills ever.

ja: ヘイヴン号爆発事故
dzh: 油輪在義大利熱那亞外海爆炸起火沉沒，油污沿利古里亞海岸擴散。
den: The tanker exploded, burned and sank off Genoa; oil spread along the Ligurian coast.
mzh: 原油約 14 萬 4 千噸

ja: ブレア号座礁事故
dzh: 油輪在暴風中於昔德蘭群島擱淺，原油大多被巨浪打散。
den: The tanker went aground on Shetland in a storm; heavy seas broke up most of the oil.
mzh: 原油約 8 萬 5 千噸

ja: シー・エンプレス号座礁事故
dzh: 油輪在威爾斯米爾福德港入口擱淺，污染彭布羅克郡海岸國家公園。
den: The tanker grounded at the entrance to Milford Haven, Wales, fouling the Pembrokeshire Coast National Park.
mzh: 原油約 7 萬 2 千噸

ja: 1997 年東南アジア煙害
dzh: 印尼蘇門答臘與婆羅洲為開墾而放火燒林與泥炭地，聖嬰年乾旱下失控，濃霾籠罩東南亞數月。
den: Fires set to clear forest and peatland in Sumatra and Borneo ran out of control in an El Niño drought; thick haze covered South-East Asia for months.

zh: 阿斯納爾科利亞爾尾礦壩潰決
ja: アスナルコリャル鉱滓ダム決壊
dzh: 西班牙礦場的尾礦壩破裂，含重金屬的酸性泥水沿瓜迪亞馬爾河流到多尼亞納國家公園邊緣。
den: A tailings dam at a Spanish mine broke and acid, metal-laden sludge ran down the Guadiamar to the edge of Doñana National Park.
mzh: 泥水約 500–600 萬立方公尺
rzh: 瓜迪亞馬爾河沿岸約 40 公里

ja: エリカ号沈没事故
dzh: 老舊油輪在比斯開灣斷裂沉沒，重油污染布列塔尼南部到旺代約 400 公里海岸。
den: An ageing tanker broke in two and sank in the Bay of Biscay; heavy fuel oil fouled about 400 km of coast from southern Brittany to the Vendée.
men: About 20,000 t of heavy fuel oil

ja: バイア・マーレのシアン化合物流出
dzh: 羅馬尼亞金礦的尾礦池潰堤，含氰化物廢水經索梅什河、蒂薩河流進多瑙河，最後到黑海，沿途魚群大量死亡。
den: A tailings pond at a Romanian gold mine overflowed; cyanide-laden water ran down the Someș and the Tisza into the Danube and on to the Black Sea, killing fish all the way.
mzh: 廢水約 10 萬立方公尺
rzh: 索梅什河、蒂薩河、多瑙河

zh: 圖盧茲 AZF 化工廠爆炸
ja: AZF 化学工場爆発事故
dzh: 法國圖盧茲的化肥廠硝酸銨倉庫爆炸，市區大片建築受損。
den: Ammonium nitrate stored at a fertiliser plant in Toulouse exploded, damaging buildings across the city.

ja: プレステージ号沈没事故
dzh: 單殼油輪在加利西亞外海破損，被拖往外海後斷裂沉沒，重油污染西班牙北岸與法國西南海岸。
den: A single-hull tanker was holed off Galicia, towed out to sea and broke up; its heavy fuel oil fouled northern Spain and south-western France.
mzh: 重油約 6 萬 3 千噸
men: About 63,000 t of heavy fuel oil
rzh: 加利西亞到法國西南（概略）

zh: 吉林石化爆炸與松花江苯污染
ja: 吉林石化爆発と松花江汚染
dzh: 吉林石化的苯胺廠爆炸，約 100 噸苯類流進松花江，污染帶經哈爾濱流到黑龍江，哈爾濱停水五天。
den: Explosions at a PetroChina aniline plant in Jilin sent about 100 t of benzene compounds into the Songhua; the slick passed Harbin, which cut its water for five days, and reached the Amur.

zh: 阿比讓有毒廢棄物傾倒
ja: アビジャン有害廃棄物投棄事件
dzh: 托克運輸公司的貨輪「普羅博無尾熊號」把有毒的石化廢料交給當地業者，傾倒在阿比讓市內十幾處。
den: Waste from the ship Probo Koala, chartered by Trafigura, was handed to a local firm and dumped at more than a dozen sites around Abidjan.

ja: ハーベイ・スピリット号原油流出事故
dzh: 油輪在韓國泰安外海遭起重船撞擊漏油，上百萬志工清理海岸。
den: A crane barge struck the tanker off Taean, South Korea; more than a million volunteers helped clean the coast.

en: Kingston Fossil Plant coal fly ash slurry spill
ja: キングストン石炭灰流出事故
dzh: 美國田納西河谷管理局燃煤電廠的煤灰池堤防潰決，煤灰泥漿覆蓋周邊住宅與河道。
den: A dike of a coal-ash pond at a TVA power plant failed and ash slurry buried homes and river channels.
mzh: 煤灰約 410 萬立方公尺
wen: Kingston Fossil Plant coal fly ash slurry spill

ja: メキシコ湾原油流出事故
dzh: 英國石油租用的鑽油平台在墨西哥灣爆炸沉沒，海底油井漏油 87 天，是美國史上最大的海上漏油。
den: A drilling rig leased by BP exploded and sank in the Gulf of Mexico; the well leaked for 87 days: the largest marine oil spill in US history.
mzh: 原油約 490 萬桶（美國政府估計）
rzh: 累積油污範圍（依美國國家海洋暨大氣總署衛星判讀簡化）
ren: Cumulative slick (simplified from NOAA satellite analyses)

ja: アイカ赤泥流出事故
dzh: 匈牙利氧化鋁廠的赤泥池潰堤，強鹼性泥流淹沒科隆塔爾等村莊，經馬爾曹河流到多瑙河。
den: A red-mud reservoir at a Hungarian alumina plant burst; the caustic sludge flooded Kolontár and other villages and reached the Danube by way of the Marcal.
mzh: 赤泥約 100 萬立方公尺
men: About 1 million m³ of red mud
rzh: 托爾瑙河、馬爾曹河到多瑙河
ren: The Torna and Marcal to the Danube

ja: 福島第一原子力発電所事故
dzh: 東日本大地震的海嘯使福島第一核電廠失去電源，三部機組爐心熔毀、氫氣爆炸。輻射直接致死經官方認定 1 人；避難導致的「震災相關死亡」在福島縣超過 2,300 人。
den: The tsunami of the Great East Japan Earthquake cut power to Fukushima Daiichi; three reactor cores melted and hydrogen explosions followed. One death has been officially attributed to radiation; more than 2,300 "disaster-related deaths" in Fukushima Prefecture followed the evacuations.
rzh: 西北方向的主要污染帶（飯館村一帶，依文部科學省航空偵測簡化）
ren: Main plume to the north-west toward Iitate (simplified from MEXT airborne surveys)

zh: 福島警戒區域與歸還困難區域
ja: 福島の警戒区域・帰還困難区域
dzh: 核電廠 20 公里內劃為警戒區域，2013 年後分區逐步解除，部分「歸還困難區域」至今仍未開放。
den: The area within 20 km was closed; zones have been reopened step by step since 2013, but some "difficult-to-return" areas remain closed.

zh: 拉克梅甘蒂克火車爆炸
ja: ラック・メガンティック鉄道事故
dzh: 無人看管的原油列車溜下坡道，在加拿大魁北克的小鎮中心出軌爆炸。
den: An unattended train of crude oil ran away down a grade and derailed and exploded in the centre of a small Quebec town.

ja: マウント・ポーリー鉱滓ダム決壊
dzh: 加拿大卑詩省銅金礦的尾礦壩潰決，廢水流進鮭魚棲息的湖泊。
den: The tailings dam of a copper and gold mine in British Columbia failed, sending waste into salmon lakes.
mzh: 尾礦與廢水約 2,500 萬立方公尺
men: About 25 million m³ of tailings and water
rzh: 黑澤爾頓溪與奎內爾湖

ja: 天津浜海新区倉庫爆発事故
dzh: 天津港瑞海公司危險品倉庫起火後連環爆炸，存放的數百噸氰化鈉等化學品外洩。
den: A fire at Ruihai's hazardous-goods warehouse in the port of Tianjin set off a chain of explosions and released hundreds of tonnes of sodium cyanide and other chemicals.
rzh: 核心區與周邊受損範圍
ren: The blast centre and damaged area around it
wzh: 2015年天津港危險品倉庫爆炸事故

ja: マリアナ鉱滓ダム決壊
dzh: 巴西淡水河谷與必和必拓合資礦場的豐當尾礦壩潰決，泥流沖毀本托羅德里格斯村，沿多西河流約 670 公里入大西洋。
den: The Fundão tailings dam of a Vale–BHP joint venture in Brazil failed; the sludge wiped out Bento Rodrigues and ran some 670 km down the Rio Doce to the Atlantic.
mzh: 尾礦約 4,300 萬立方公尺
ren: The Rio Doce to its mouth

zh: 台塑河靜鋼廠海洋污染
ja: ベトナム中部の魚大量死（台湾プラスチック河静製鉄所）
dzh: 台塑集團在越南河靜省的鋼廠排放含酚與氰化物的廢水，中部四省約 200 公里海岸魚群大量死亡；台塑承認責任並賠償 5 億美元。
den: Waste water containing phenols and cyanide from Formosa Plastics' steel works in Hà Tĩnh killed fish along some 200 km of coast in four provinces of central Vietnam; the company admitted responsibility and paid US$500 million.
rzh: 越南中部四省沿岸約 200 公里
ren: About 200 km of coast in four provinces

ja: サンチ号衝突事故
dzh: 伊朗油輪桑吉號在長江口外海與貨輪相撞起火，燃燒一週後沉沒，船員全數罹難，凝析油外洩。
den: The Iranian tanker Sanchi collided with a freighter off the Yangtze estuary, burned for a week and sank; all her crew died and her condensate cargo escaped.
mzh: 凝析油約 13 萬 6 千噸

zh: 布魯馬迪紐尾礦壩潰決
ja: ブルマジーニョ鉱滓ダム決壊
dzh: 淡水河谷鐵礦的尾礦壩在午餐時間潰決，泥流吞沒礦場餐廳與下游社區，流進帕拉奧佩巴河。
den: The tailings dam of a Vale iron mine collapsed at lunchtime; the mudflow buried the mine canteen and the community below and entered the Paraopeba.
mzh: 尾礦約 1,200 萬立方公尺
rzh: 費若溪與帕拉奧佩巴河

ja: 響水化学工場爆発事故
dzh: 江蘇響水陳家港化工園區的天嘉宜化工廠爆炸，周邊村莊與學校受損，事後整個園區關閉。
den: The Tianjiayi chemical plant in the Chenjiagang chemical park, Xiangshui, Jiangsu, exploded, damaging villages and schools around it; the whole park was later closed.
wzh: 響水「3·21」特別重大爆炸事故

zh: 維沙卡帕特南苯乙烯外洩
ja: ヴィシャーカパトナムのスチレン漏洩事故
dzh: 新冠封城後重新開工的 LG 化學工廠儲槽苯乙烯外洩，周邊村莊居民在睡夢中中毒。
den: Styrene escaped from a tank at an LG Polymers plant restarting after the Covid lockdown; villagers nearby were poisoned in their sleep.

zh: 若潮號擱淺漏油（模里西斯）
ja: わかしお座礁事故（モーリシャス）
dzh: 日本長鋪汽船所屬、商船三井租用的散裝船在模里西斯外海珊瑚礁擱淺，燃油污染紅樹林與潟湖。
den: A bulk carrier owned by Japan's Nagashiki Shipping and chartered by MOL ran onto the reef off Mauritius; her fuel oil fouled mangroves and lagoons.

ja: ベイルート港爆発事故
dzh: 存放在貝魯特港倉庫多年的約 2,750 噸硝酸銨爆炸，摧毀港區並重創半個城市。
den: About 2,750 t of ammonium nitrate stored for years in a warehouse at the port of Beirut exploded, destroying the port and wrecking half the city.
mzh: 約 7,000 人受傷、30 萬人無家可歸
rzh: 嚴重受損範圍約 5 公里

zh: X-Press Pearl 號塑膠粒污染
ja: エックスプレス・パール号火災
dzh: 載運化學品的貨櫃船在斯里蘭卡可倫坡外海起火沉沒，大量塑膠粒沖上海岸，是史上最嚴重的塑膠污染事件。
den: A container ship carrying chemicals burned and sank off Colombo; enormous amounts of plastic pellets washed ashore, the worst plastic spill on record.

ja: カホフカ・ダム決壊
dzh: 俄烏戰爭中，俄軍控制下的卡霍夫卡水壩遭破壞崩潰，第聶伯河下游大片淹沒，水庫乾涸。各方認定以俄方蓄意爆破的可能最大。
den: The Kakhovka Dam, held by Russian forces, was breached during the war; the lower Dnieper flooded and the reservoir drained. Most investigations point to deliberate demolition by Russia.
rzh: 第聶伯河下游與赫爾松一帶（示意）

ja: イーストパレスタイン列車脱線事故
dzh: 載有氯乙烯的貨運列車在俄亥俄州出軌，當局為防爆炸控制燃燒，居民一度撤離。
den: A freight train carrying vinyl chloride derailed in Ohio; to prevent an explosion it was burned off and residents were evacuated for a time.

ja: デルナのダム決壊
dzh: 風暴丹尼爾的豪雨使利比亞德爾納上游兩座年久失修的水壩相繼潰決，洪水沖走市中心大片街區；死亡人數各方說法從四千多到一萬以上。
den: Storm Daniel's rain made two long-neglected dams above Derna, Libya, collapse one after the other; the flood swept away much of the city centre. Death tolls range from over 4,000 to more than 10,000.
ren: Wadi Derna and the city centre

ja: アラル海の縮小
dzh: 蘇聯為灌溉棉田大量引走阿姆河與錫爾河的水，曾是世界第四大湖的鹹海在數十年間萎縮到原來的一成左右，鹽塵與農藥揚起危害周邊居民。
den: Soviet irrigation of cotton diverted the Amu Darya and Syr Darya; once the world's fourth-largest lake, the Aral Sea shrank to about a tenth of its size, and salt and pesticide dust blew over the people around it.
ren: The lake as it was in 1960 (rough)

zh: 尼日河三角洲石油污染
en: Oil spills in the Niger Delta
ja: ニジェール・デルタの石油汚染
dzh: 1958 年起開採石油以來，管線破裂、盜油與燃燒伴生氣長年污染尼日河三角洲的河道、紅樹林與農田，奧格尼蘭的清理至今未完成。
den: Since oil production began in 1958, broken pipelines, oil theft and gas flaring have polluted the creeks, mangroves and farms of the Niger Delta; the clean-up of Ogoniland is still unfinished.
wen: Environmental issues in the Niger Delta

ja: 太平洋ごみベルト
dzh: 北太平洋環流把各地漂來的塑膠垃圾聚集在夏威夷與加州之間的海域，1997 年由航海者摩爾注意到並引起關注。
den: The North Pacific Gyre gathers floating plastic from around the ocean between Hawaii and California; the sailor Charles Moore drew attention to it in 1997.
rzh: 東太平洋垃圾聚集區（概略）

zh: 米糠油多氯聯苯中毒（油症）
ja: 台湾油症事件
dzh: 彰化油脂公司生產的米糠油在加熱過程混入多氯聯苯，中部約兩千人食用後皮膚長出氯痤瘡、肝功能受損，台中惠明學校師生最先發病；受害者的下一代也受影響。
den: Rice-bran oil made by Changhua Oil was contaminated with PCBs from its heating system. About two thousand people in central Taiwan, beginning with the staff and pupils of the Huiming School for the blind, developed chloracne and liver damage; their children were affected too.
rzh: 台中、彰化一帶受害者分布（示意）

ja: 観音カドミウム米事件
dzh: 桃園觀音的高銀化工排放含鎘廢水進入灌溉渠道，周邊稻米鎘含量超標，農地被迫休耕，整治延續到 2000 年代。
den: Kaoyin Chemical in Guanyin, Taoyuan, discharged cadmium-laden waste water into irrigation channels; rice from the fields around exceeded safe levels and the land was taken out of farming, with clean-up lasting into the 2000s.

en: Green oysters of the Erren River
ja: 二仁渓の緑色カキ事件
dzh: 二仁溪沿岸露天燃燒廢五金、酸洗回收金屬，銅等重金屬流進出海口，牡蠣被染成綠色，成為台灣河川污染的代表事件。
den: Open burning and acid-stripping of scrap metal along the Erren River sent copper and other metals into the estuary; the oysters there turned green, a landmark of river pollution in Taiwan.

ja: 林園事件
dzh: 林園石化工業區的廢水處理廠廢水溢流，附近魚塭魚群暴斃，居民包圍工業區要求賠償，石化廠停工，業者最後支付十多億元補償。
den: The waste-water plant of the Linyuan petrochemical zone overflowed and killed the fish in nearby ponds; residents besieged the zone and the plants stopped until the companies paid more than NT$1 billion in compensation.

ja: RCA 桃園工場汚染事件
dzh: 美國無線電公司桃園廠長年傾倒三氯乙烯等有機溶劑，地下水嚴重污染，許多前員工罹癌；1994 年經立委揭露，員工訴訟纏訟二十多年後勝訴。
den: RCA's Taoyuan plant had dumped trichloroethylene and other solvents for years, badly contaminating the groundwater; many former workers developed cancer. Exposed by a legislator in 1994, the workers' lawsuit was won after more than two decades.
men: More than a thousand former workers with cancer
rzh: 廠區與地下水污染範圍（示意）
ren: The plant and the groundwater plume (sketch)

en: Formosa Plastics mercury waste in Cambodia
ja: 台湾プラスチックの水銀汚泥カンボジア投棄
dzh: 台塑把約三千噸含汞污泥運到柬埔寨施亞努港附近傾倒，引發當地恐慌與暴動，污泥最後運回台灣。
den: Formosa Plastics shipped about 3,000 t of mercury-laden sludge to Cambodia and dumped it near Sihanoukville; panic and riots followed, and the waste was finally shipped back to Taiwan.

ja: アモルゴス号座礁事故
dzh: 希臘籍貨輪阿瑪斯號在墾丁國家公園龍坑生態保護區外擱淺，約 1,150 噸燃油外洩，污染珊瑚礁海岸，是台灣首件重大海洋油污事件。
den: The Greek freighter Amorgos ran aground off the Longkeng reserve in Kenting National Park; about 1,150 t of fuel oil fouled the coral coast, Taiwan's first major marine oil spill.
wzh: 阿瑪斯號貨輪漏油事件

ja: 第三原発の全交流電源喪失
dzh: 鹽霧造成輸電線路閃絡，核三廠一號機失去全部交流電源約兩小時，緊急柴油發電機也未能啟動，未造成輻射外洩。
den: Salt-fog flashovers on the lines left Unit 1 of the Maanshan plant without any AC power for about two hours, and the emergency diesels failed to start; no radiation was released.

zh: 中石化安順廠戴奧辛與汞污染
ja: 中石化安順工場のダイオキシン・水銀汚染
dzh: 台南安南區的舊鹼氯工廠留下大量戴奧辛與汞，2001 年起驗出附近魚塭與居民血液戴奧辛偏高，土地至今仍在整治。
den: A former chlor-alkali plant in Annan, Tainan, left heavy dioxin and mercury contamination; from 2001 high dioxin levels were found in nearby fish ponds and in residents' blood, and remediation continues.
ren: The plant and the Luermen creek

ja: 台塑六軽の大火災
dzh: 雲林麥寮的台塑六輕工業區一個月內兩度大火，濃煙引發周邊居民與養殖業的健康與損害爭議。
den: The Formosa Plastics complex at Mailiao, Yunlin, had two large fires within a month; the smoke led to disputes over health and damage to nearby farms and fish ponds.

ja: 高雄ガス爆発事故
dzh: 埋在高雄前鎮、苓雅區道路下的丙烯管線外洩，深夜沿凱旋三路、一心一路、三多一路等街道連環爆炸，路面被掀開數公里。
den: A propylene pipeline under the streets of Qianzhen and Lingya, Kaohsiung, leaked; late at night the gas exploded along Kaisyuan, Yisin and Sanduo roads, tearing open kilometres of road.

ja: 八仙水上楽園粉塵爆発事故
dzh: 新北八里八仙樂園的派對噴灑大量彩色玉米粉，遇熱燃起粉塵爆炸，數百名年輕人嚴重燒傷。
den: Coloured corn starch sprayed over a party at Formosa Fun Coast in Bali, New Taipei, caught fire as a dust explosion; hundreds of young people were badly burned.
wzh: 八仙樂園粉塵爆炸事故

ja: TS タイペイ号座礁事故
dzh: 德翔海運貨櫃輪在新北石門外海擱淺，船身斷裂後燃油外洩，污染北海岸。
den: A T.S. Lines container ship ran aground off Shimen, New Taipei; she broke up and her fuel oil fouled the north coast.

ja: 蘭嶼の核廃棄物貯蔵場
dzh: 台電 1982 年起把核電廠的低放射性廢料運到達悟族居住的蘭嶼存放，部分鐵桶鏽蝕，族人長年抗爭要求遷出，至今仍未遷走。
den: From 1982 Taipower stored low-level waste from its reactors on Lanyu, home of the Tao people. Some drums corroded; the Tao have long campaigned for its removal, which has not yet happened.
mzh: 約 10 萬桶低放射性廢料

ja: 屏東明揚工場火災
dzh: 屏東科技產業園區的明揚國際高爾夫球廠起火，存放的過氧化物爆炸，四名消防員殉職。
den: A fire at the Mingyang golf-ball factory in the Pingtung industrial park set off stored peroxides; four firefighters were among the dead.
wzh: 明揚國際科技工廠火災

ja: 足尾鉱毒事件
dzh: 古河足尾銅山的礦毒與煙害使渡良瀨川流域農地荒廢，1890 年洪水後災情擴大；田中正造為此向天皇直訴，被稱為日本公害的原點。
den: Waste and fumes from the Furukawa company's Ashio copper mine ruined the farmland of the Watarase basin, worst after the flood of 1890. Tanaka Shōzō petitioned the Emperor over it; it is called the starting point of pollution in Japan.

ja: 森永ヒ素ミルク中毒事件
dzh: 森永乳業德島工廠的嬰兒奶粉混入含砷的工業用添加物，西日本一萬多名嬰兒中毒，百餘人死亡，許多人留下後遺症。
den: Infant formula from Morinaga's Tokushima factory was made with an industrial additive containing arsenic; more than ten thousand babies in western Japan were poisoned, over a hundred died and many were left with lasting harm.
mzh: 受害嬰兒約 1 萬 3 千人
wja: 森永ヒ素ミルク中毒事件

ja: 水俣病
dzh: 窒素公司水俣工廠把含甲基汞的廢水排進水俣灣，魚貝類累積汞毒，不知火海沿岸居民出現神經病變；1956 年正式發現，政府到 1968 年才認定是公害。
den: Chisso's Minamata factory discharged methylmercury into Minamata Bay; it built up in fish and shellfish, and people around the Shiranui Sea suffered nerve damage. Officially discovered in 1956, it was recognised as pollution by the government only in 1968.
rzh: 水俣灣與不知火海沿岸
ren: Minamata Bay and the Shiranui Sea coast

ja: 四日市ぜんそく
dzh: 四日市石化聯合廠排放的二氧化硫造成周邊居民大量氣喘，1972 年患者勝訴，促使日本建立總量管制。
den: Sulphur dioxide from the Yokkaichi petrochemical complex gave asthma to many people around it; the patients won their lawsuit in 1972, leading Japan to cap total emissions.

ja: 新潟水俣病
dzh: 昭和電工鹿瀨工廠排放的甲基汞污染阿賀野川，下游居民食魚中毒，是日本四大公害病之一。
den: Methylmercury from Shōwa Denkō's Kanose plant polluted the Agano River, and people downstream were poisoned by the fish: one of Japan's four big pollution diseases.

ja: イタイイタイ病
dzh: 三井金屬神岡礦山排出的鎘污染神通川，下游稻米與飲水累積鎘，居民骨骼軟化疼痛；1968 年成為日本第一個政府認定的公害病，農地整治到 2012 年才完成。
den: Cadmium from the Mitsui Kamioka mine polluted the Jinzū River and the rice and water downstream, softening people's bones painfully. In 1968 it became the first pollution disease recognised by the Japanese government; the farmland was not cleaned up until 2012.

ja: カネミ油症事件
dzh: 北九州 Kanemi 倉庫公司生產的米糠油，在脫臭加熱時混入作為熱媒的多氯聯苯（鐘淵化學製）與戴奧辛，福岡、長崎等西日本一帶大量受害，受害者的下一代也受影響；十一年後台灣發生類似的油症事件。
den: Rice-bran oil made by Kanemi in Kitakyūshū was contaminated with PCBs and dioxins from its heating system; many people in Fukuoka, Nagasaki and elsewhere in western Japan were harmed, as were their children. Taiwan had a similar poisoning eleven years later.
mzh: 受害申報約 1 萬 4 千人

ja: 東京の光化学スモッグ
dzh: 東京杉並區的立正高中學生在操場上課時紛紛眼睛刺痛、呼吸困難，是日本首次確認的光化學煙霧受害。
den: Pupils exercising at Risshō High School in Suginami, Tokyo, collapsed with stinging eyes and trouble breathing: the first recognised harm from photochemical smog in Japan.

ja: 土呂久ヒ素公害
dzh: 宮崎縣高千穗町土呂久礦山燒製亞砷酸的煙害長年毒害村民，1971 年經小學教師調查揭露。
den: Fumes from roasting arsenic ore at the Toroku mine in Takachiho, Miyazaki, poisoned villagers for decades; a primary-school teacher's survey exposed it in 1971.

ja: 三菱石油水島製油所重油流出事故
dzh: 岡山水島的三菱石油煉油廠儲油槽破裂，重油流進瀨戶內海，擴散到香川、德島沿岸，漁業損失慘重。
den: A tank at Mitsubishi Oil's Mizushima refinery in Okayama ruptured; heavy oil spread through the Seto Inland Sea to the coasts of Kagawa and Tokushima, devastating fisheries.
wja: 三菱石油水島製油所重油流出事故

ja: もんじゅナトリウム漏洩事故
dzh: 福井縣敦賀的快滋生原型爐「文殊」冷卻用的液態鈉外洩起火，營運單位隱匿現場影片，反應爐長期停機後於 2016 年決定除役。
den: Liquid sodium coolant leaked and burned at the Monju prototype fast breeder in Tsuruga, Fukui; the operator hid video of the scene, and the reactor stood idle for years until it was decommissioned from 2016.

ja: ナホトカ号重油流出事故
dzh: 俄羅斯油輪納霍德卡號在隱岐群島外海斷裂沉沒，船首漂到福井三國町，重油污染島根到秋田的日本海沿岸，約 30 萬名志工清理。
den: The Russian tanker Nakhodka broke up and sank off the Oki Islands; her bow drifted to Mikuni, Fukui, and heavy oil fouled the Sea of Japan coast from Shimane to Akita. About 300,000 volunteers helped clean it.
wja: ナホトカ号重油流出事故

zh: 東海再處理廠瀝青固化設施火災爆炸
ja: 動燃東海事業所アスファルト固化処理施設火災爆発事故
dzh: 動力爐核燃料開發事業團東海事業所的瀝青固化設施起火爆炸，工作人員受輕微曝露。
den: A fire and explosion at the bitumen solidification facility of PNC's Tokai works exposed workers to small doses.
wja: 動燃東海事業所火災爆発事故

zh: 東海村 JCO 臨界事故
ja: 東海村 JCO 臨界事故
dzh: JCO 的鈾轉換工廠作業員違規以水桶把鈾溶液倒進沉澱槽，引發臨界反應持續約 20 小時；兩名作業員死亡，350 公尺內居民撤離、10 公里內約 31 萬人被要求留在室內。
den: Workers at JCO's uranium plant poured uranyl solution into a precipitation tank by bucket against the rules; a chain reaction ran for about 20 hours. Two workers died; people within 350 m were evacuated and some 310,000 within 10 km were told to stay indoors.

zh: 美濱核電廠蒸汽管破裂
ja: 美浜発電所 3 号機配管破損事故
dzh: 關西電力美濱三號機的二次冷卻系統管線因長期未檢查而減薄破裂，高溫蒸汽噴出，正在準備定檢的工人死傷；沒有輻射外洩。
den: A secondary-loop pipe at Kansai Electric's Mihama 3, thinned and never inspected, burst; scalding steam killed and injured workers preparing an inspection. No radiation escaped.

ja: 藤沼ダム決壊
dzh: 東日本大地震中，福島縣須賀川市的農業用藤沼水庫土堤崩潰，洪水沖毀下游的長沼地區。
den: In the Great East Japan Earthquake the earth embankment of the Fujinuma irrigation reservoir in Sukagawa, Fukushima, collapsed and the flood swept the Naganuma district below.

ja: 熱海市伊豆山土石流災害
dzh: 靜岡縣熱海市伊豆山上游違規堆置的盛土在豪雨中崩落，土石流沖下逢初川沿岸住宅；之後日本制定《盛土規制法》。
den: Illegal fill heaped above Izusan in Atami, Shizuoka, collapsed in heavy rain and a debris flow ran down the Aizome River through the houses; Japan then passed a law regulating fill.
wja: 熱海市伊豆山土石流災害
